flags: SPLIT candidate: Eagle Point (site centre ~40.7700,-82.3825, own entrance on the north side of SR 430 west of the causeway; electric sites with spigots only, sites 400-612) vs Main Camp (centre ~40.7672,-82.3738, entrance on SR 430 east of the causeway at 1277A OH-430; full hookup majority).
